key_insight: A mixed finite element formulation couples heat, particle concentration, and flow to model heat-assisted consolidation and sedimentation.
engineering_relevance: The model supports analysis of thermal effects in mineral-suspension sedimentation, relevant to separation and thickening processes.
method: Formulate the quasi-stationary coupled system using pseudostress and temperature/concentration gradient variables.
Establish continuous well-posedness using Babuška–Brezzi theory and Banach’s fixed-point theorem.
Analyze a mixed finite element discretization, proving discrete existence and deriving Céa-type and a priori error estimates.
evidence_signal: Numerical examples demonstrate model performance and confirm theoretical convergence rates; the abstract reports no experimental validation.
watch_item: Continuous existence and uniqueness require small-data and additional solution-regularity assumptions, limiting guarantees outside those conditions.
paper_title: Mixed finite element methods for a heat-assisted model of sedimentation
